note: Standard Bank Eswatini's pricing guide (effective 5 December 2025, published as its July 2026 guide): the Consumer (formerly Blue) account on pay-as-you-transact costs 23.82 emalangeni a month; its transaction charges aren't counted.

sources.title: Standard Bank Eswatini, Pricing Guide (effective 5 December 2025)
sources.said: Effective from 5th December 2025 ... MONTHLY ACCOUNT FEES ... Consumer (Formerly Blue) ... Pay-as-you-transact ... Blue: E23.82
